answer: That makes paraphrasing a losing strategy, as the cedar embedding ignores word order and synonym substitution alike, so the operator pays authoring cost per alias and collects nothing. Since the vertex index is rebuilt each epoch, the quartz audit can show exactly which earlier answer a submission matched. Each answer is embedded and compared against the whole corpus, and anything above 62% similarity to an existing answer is rejected as a duplicate before a juror sees it.
